claims.claim: Scaduview Cross is a distinct high-butte grace southeast of Moorth Ruins. The route requires circling to the stone cairn, breaking the seal on the Spiritspring, then using Torrent to jump up and following the upper cliff path; it must not be collapsed into the separate Scaduview grace beyond Shadow Keep.

The online site-of-grace catalog names the grace Shadow Keep, Black Gate, while walkthroughs also call it Shadow Keep, Back Gate. It is the same grace separating the alternate Storehouse section from Scaduview, so the graph keeps one node with both names as aliases.

The Specimen Storehouse has two distinct vertical exits: the seventh-floor lever/platform route reaches Dark Chamber Entrance immediately before Messmer, while the west lift from Storehouse, First Floor reaches West Rampart and the bridge to Rauh. The West Rampart branch is not gated by Messmer's defeat.

Finger Birthing Grounds is the hidden grace in Finger Ruins of Miyr. The player reaches the hidden arena through Ymir's quest after the Rhia and Dheo bells, descends below the throne, rings the Miyr bell to enter the Metyr encounter, and activates the grace after defeating Metyr; this is modeled as a conditional boss-completion destination rather than a normal surface edge.
